title.id: Sabda Konfusius dan Kitab Bakti (Xiao Jing)
title.en: The Sayings of Confucius and the Book of Filial Duty

description.id: Terjemahan kedua Analects oleh Leonard Lyall, dan Xiao Jing, kitab tentang bakti, terjemahan Ivan Chen.
description.en: A second translation of the Analects by Leonard Lyall, and the Xiao Jing on filial duty translated by Ivan Chen.
